notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[H3] [b] small update content update [/ b] [/ H3]
1. Solved the problem that the game pause menu button cannot be used
2. Solved the problem that the footsteps of zombies are too loud
3. The recoil force of the gun is adjusted to improve the authenticity
4. Added more zombie models, no longer making zombies more single
5. Update game UI
If you have better suggestions, please join our QQ group
